description: ✨ Just Your Basic Sugar Cookie Recipe ✨ This is the recipe you turn to when someone you love says, I want cookies. It’s simple, classic, and it took me less than 30 minutes to whip up! Enjoy them like we did 💛 ✨ Ingredients ✨ 	•	1 cup butter (softened) 	•	2½ cups all-purpose flour 	•	1¼ cup granulated sugar (+ extra for rolling) 	•	1 egg 	•	2 tsp vanilla 	•	½ tsp baking soda 	•	½ tsp baking powder 	•	¼ tsp salt 👩‍🍳 Directions 👩‍🍳 	1.	Preheat oven to 350°F. 	2.	Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 1 min). 	3.	Add egg and vanilla, mix until combined. 	4.	Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt . Mix until just combined. 	5.	Roll dough into balls, coat in sugar, and bake for 10–11 minutes. 	6.	Let them cool on the pan. And enjoy those soft sugar cookies! 🍪 #baking #ComfortFood #sugarcookies #holidayrecipes #fyp
transcript: Let's make the easiest cookies you're ever gonna bake. Start by creaming your butter and sugar together. This part takes the longest, so be patient. Once it's nice and smooth, crack your egg in and add your vanilla, and give that another good mix. Pour your dry ingredients in and knead that dough together just until it comes together. Go ahead and grab yourself a small bowl of sugar and roll your dough into balls. Coat those balls with sugar and if you haven't already preheat your oven to 350, bake for about 10 to 11 minutes and let them cool right on the pan until they fall. And just like that, you have soft, buttery sugar cookies ready to share with your family. Enjoy.
